name: Todar Mal
role: Finance minister to Mughal emperor Akbar
contribution: An Indian minister, economist, writer and military commander who served as the finance minister of the Mughal Empire during the reign of Akbar.

checks.lead: Raja Todar Mal (1523/24 – 8 November 1589) was an Indian minister, economist, writer and military commander who served as the finance minister (Dēwān-i-Aśraf) of the Mughal Empire during the reign of Akbar. He was also the Wakīl as-Salt̤anat (Counsellor of the Empire) and the joint Wazir.
